title: Sum of a vector, recursively
statement: Write a recursive SumVector function that takes an array of 5 integers by reference, a starting index and a size, and returns the sum of the elements from that index to the end. Solve it with pure recursion, with no loop at all. Read 5 numbers and write the sum of the whole vector.
